g.text: Where the named genes sit relative to the limits

text.style: font-size: 11px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #617481

g.text: Each cell shows the largest supported RNA value ÷ its own applicable ceiling. Ratios >1 fail that RNA gate.

text.style: font-size: 9px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #617481

g.text: ✓ selected · × excluded. Gray dash = no supported statistic, not a measured zero. Zero = supported source measurement of zero.

text.style: font-size: 9px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #617481

g.text: Only ratios to each source's policy ceiling are compared; native RNA units are retained. No missing panel is interpreted as absence.

text.style: font-size: 9px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; fill: #617481

g.text: PRAME: heart fibroblasts 12/2 = 6×. CTAG2: bronchial basal cells 24.9/2 = 12.45×. SMC1B: DICE 3.50/4 = 0.87×.
